tool: gpt-image 스킬(Codex 내장 image_gen, ChatGPT 구독 인증)
prompt:
Full-body front-view character reference of an ordinary Korean male police patrol officer in his mid thirties for 3D rigging. He has come to an old four-storey brick villa on a humid late-July morning to check on a missing-person report: calm, polite and professional, a little tired from a night shift. Short neat black hair, clean-shaven, a plain everyday face, neutral expression, eyes looking straight ahead. Outfit: Korean police summer duty uniform: a short-sleeved dark navy-blue uniform shirt with dark navy shoulder epaulettes and a plain dark navy-blue round patch on the left upper sleeve, dark navy-blue uniform trousers, a black leather duty belt with a black handheld radio on the left hip and a small black pouch on the right hip, black leather duty shoes, a pale lemon-yellow reflective safety vest worn open over the shirt with two silver reflective horizontal stripes and no lettering, and a dark navy-blue peaked police patrol cap with a small plain gold badge on the front. Average build, about 175 cm tall. Pose for 3D rigging: standing straight and facing the camera, feet about shoulder-width apart, a relaxed A-pose with both arms held straight and about 40 degrees away from the body, so the hands hang clearly away from the hips and thighs and there is wide empty background space between each arm and the torso all the way down to the fingertips, fingers relaxed, hands empty. Realistic proportions and clothing folds, an ordinary person, nothing supernatural, no readable letters or numbers anywhere on the uniform, cap, belt or radio.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, lighting variation, or scenery.
Constraints: do not use #00ff00 or any green reflected spill anywhere on the subject; crisp silhouette suitable for chroma removal; generous green padding around the silhouette; no part of the subject cut off by the frame edge; no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no border, no cast shadow on the green background.
Rendering discipline (critical): resolve every surface with gentle continuous gradients, never with fine dots. Absolutely no per-pixel noise of any kind: no stippling, no dithering, no halftone or screen-door pattern, no pointillist speckle, no sand or dust overlay, no crosshatch, no chromatic speckle, no oversharpened edge halos, no JPEG mosquito artifacts, no added film grain. Prefer slightly soft over crunchy; if uncertain, make it smoother. Restrained detail that still reads at 512 px. Soft neutral cool light on the subject only, no rim light, no bloom, no colour grading, no depth of field, no motion blur, no baked contact shadow.
usage: 셋째 아침 5층 현장 확인에 오는 순찰 경찰관(30대 중반)의 몸. 처음에는 팔을 25도 벌린 안(조끼 있는 것, 없는 것)을 뽑았는데, 손이 엉덩이 가까이 와서 TRELLIS가 팔 안쪽과 옆구리 사이를 얇은 면으로 메웠고 벽을 두드리려고 팔을 들면 그 면이 손에서 허리까지 늘어났다. 그래서 팔을 40도 벌린 A자 자세로 다시 뽑아 이것을 쓴다. TRELLIS 생성 → rig_walker --profile officer(서 있을 때는 팔을 허벅지 옆으로 모은다).
